headline.why: the residual is the complement of both numerators: classifying it cannot change a ratio whose numerator and denominator are the storing reads and the name-matched reads, so no republish is owed (E382's rule is for splits that move a headline)

method: static only, zero network: E392's population, resolver, statuses and scan are imported and E393's uncapped reader is installed in place of E392's, so the population is the one E393 measured. Every read that resolves to a face lacking its key is classified as depth / producer / another face / unparsed / dead, and only the last is published as a broken reader.
refusals: depth is a nested dict-key test on the parsed document, never a substring test
a face above the read cap is not parsed, and its rows are published as unparsed
the producer test shows a producer can write the key, not that it did this run
another-face uses the key population's own file list, so no face is invented
the study does not scan itself, its face, its mirror or its smoke leg
the walk is the same py_corpus E391 used, so the population filter matches
